glance.headline: UN Fails to Agree on Killer Robot Rules
glance.summary: UN diplomats meeting in Geneva failed to agree on rules for autonomous weapons, leaving after agreeing to "start discussing options".
glance.why: It highlights global challenges in agreeing on rules for autonomous weapons that act without human control.

explain.kid: UN diplomats met in Geneva this week to work on rules for autonomous weapons, also called killer robots. The UN failed to agree on rules to regulate them. After a mostly fruitless week of talks, representatives left the meetings agreeing to start discussing options.
explain.pm: UN diplomats in Geneva failed to agree on rules for autonomous weapons, leaving after agreeing to "start discussing options".
explain.engineer: Geneva negotiations on rules for autonomous weapons ended without agreement, with parties agreeing only to "start discussing options".
